messages.subject: Brms models within functions
parts:
Dear google-group members,

I wish to implement a model (using the psychometric function) to investigate binary outcome responses between an upper and a lower asymptote. I have been doing this in Stan using the following model statement:

Y ~ bernoulli(lower_asymptote + (1 – upper_asymptote – lower_asymptote)*inv_logit(mu));

where mu = X * beta + Intercept


Is it possible to implement such model in Brms, for which the family, in this instance bernoulli(link = "logit"), does not apply to the entirety of the response distribution? If so, how can this be done with a brms formula?


Kind regards,
John

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Brms models within functions
parts: Can you reformulate the model so that everything is enclosed in the response distribution? If yes, you can fit it with brms' non-linear syntax. See vignette("brms_nonlinear")
